method: Shared Session owner enabled in every run. Before build uses pre-change HEAD versions of window-preparation-intent.ts, prepared-window.ts and window-warm-service.ts; all other application/CLI source and dependencies match. Final output and sources restored after comparison. Three warmups excluded per latency run.
scope: M4 Max/macOS/Electron 43.7.6; fresh profiles; synthetic 3000-entry Session; retarget scenario adds a second synthetic Session.
limits: Small sequential samples; fixed synthetic pointer intent lead times do not establish real-user hit rates or population P95.
Native show and synthetic text insertion are not display scanout, physical input or IME latency.
Zero-lead unprepared clicks still pay rendering; this does not promise universally instantaneous opening.
Retarget verifies renderer PID reuse and matching visible target. Return probe waits three seconds after pointer exit. No multi-slot pool is added.
Single renderer is not a hard memory-byte cap: distinct Session stores retain their existing ten-minute cache grace period.

excludedAttempts.reason: macOS footprint VM-region scan failed during teardown, including after waiting for renderer exit. Final probe reads the kernel footprint counter through proc_pid_rusage without traversing VM regions; no application crash occurred.
